title: High Contrast Cloth Book
author: IntelliBaby
description: Soft crinkly cloth pages with bold black, white and bright patterns that a newborn's eyes can follow.

title: The Very Hungry Caterpillar
author: Eric Carle
description: A little caterpillar eats his way through the week, with holes to poke fingers through and counting along the way.

title: Goodnight Moon
author: Margaret Wise Brown
description: A gentle rhyming goodnight to everything in the great green room, made for winding down.

title: The Gruffalo
author: Julia Donaldson
description: A clever mouse invents a monster to stay safe in the woods, in bouncy rhyme.

title: We're Going on a Bear Hunt
author: Michael Rosen
description: A family wades, squelches and stumbles through grass, mud and snow; made for actions and sound effects.

title: Where Is Baby's Belly Button?
author: Karen Katz
description: Lift the flaps to find hands, toes and a belly button, with peekaboo fun.

title: Baby Faces
author: DK
description: Photographs of babies' real expressions help little ones recognise smiles, surprise and giggles.

title: Ten Little Fingers and Ten Little Toes
author: Mem Fox
description: Babies from all over the world, each with ten fingers and ten toes, and a sweet surprise at the end.

title: Dear Zoo
author: Rod Campbell
description: A lift-the-flap story where each animal sent from the zoo is too big, too tall or too fierce to keep.

title: Moo, Baa, La La La!
author: Sandra Boynton
description: Cows moo, sheep baa and three singing pigs go la la la, a silly board book for animal sounds.

title: Spot Looks at Shapes
author: Eric Hill
description: Spot the puppy spots circles, squares and triangles in everyday things, with flaps to lift.

title: Where's Spot?
author: Eric Hill
description: Spot's mum searches for him behind doors, clocks and baskets in the classic lift-the-flap story.

title: The Going to Bed Book
author: Sandra Boynton
description: A silly crew on a ship takes baths, puts on pyjamas and settles down for the night.

title: Brown Bear, Brown Bear, What Do You See?
author: Bill Martin Jr.
description: A repeating question-and-answer rhyme that introduces animals and colours one page at a time.

title: Chicka Chicka Boom Boom
author: Bill Martin Jr. and John Archambault
description: The letters of the alphabet race up a coconut tree in a rhythmic rhyme.

title: The Very Busy Spider
author: Eric Carle
description: A spider spins her web all day while the farm animals call to her; raised lines let little fingers feel the web.

title: Fox's Socks
author: Julia Donaldson
description: Fox has lost his socks, and lift-the-flap pages help him find them in rhyming Acorn Wood.

title: Goodnight, Goodnight, Construction Site
author: Sherri Duskey Rinker
description: Diggers, cranes and cement mixers finish their jobs and settle down to sleep.

title: From Head to Toe
author: Eric Carle
description: Animals show a move, and children answer 'I can do it!', so it works as a game with actions.

title: Llama Llama Red Pajama
author: Anna Dewdney
description: Baby Llama worries at bedtime when Mama is downstairs, and learns that she always comes back.

title: On the Night You Were Born
author: Nancy Tillman
description: A tender poem about how special and loved a child is, from the moment they were born.

title: Hello World! Planet Earth
author: Jill McDonald
description: A bright board book that says hello to oceans, mountains, forests and the weather.

title: Hello, World! Solar System
author: Jill McDonald
description: A first look at the sun, the planets and the moon in simple words and colourful pictures.

title: Where Do Diggers Sleep at Night?
author: Brianna Caplan Sayres
description: A rhyming tour of where bulldozers, cranes and dump trucks park for the night.

title: I Love You Through and Through
author: Bernadette Rossetti-Shustak
description: A comforting rhyme that tells a child they are loved inside and out, happy or sad.

title: Future Engineer
description: A board book for curious builders who like to make and fix things.

title: Toot Toot Beep Beep
author: Emma Garcia
description: Vehicles and their sounds on bright pages, made for beeping and tooting along.

title: Let's Say Our Colors
description: A first colours book that invites toddlers to name each colour out loud.

title: Let's Say Our Numbers
description: A first counting book that invites toddlers to say the numbers along.

title: I Love You to the Moon and Back
author: Amelia Hepworth
description: A bear and a cub share all the ways they love each other, a cuddly goodnight read.
